events_summary.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
events_summary.content: Tell the Duke.
Close-up framed into a cracked wooden wall mirror reflecting Alexander with long unkempt hair, a thick beard, and combat scars across his cheek.
Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.
Tilt-down medium close-up over a wooden table displaying a pristine navy-and-gold embroidered ducal uniform, ornate lion crest brooch, white cravat, razor, and scissors.
Medium profile shot of Alexander lifting the metal shears beside the window light, raising them toward his hair.
Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.
Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.
Medium shot as Alexander trims his beard at the jawline.
Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.
Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Enough hiding.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Today, he comes home.
Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.
Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.

hook: Opens with immediate physical drama: Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.
cliffhanger: Cuts sharply on ALEXANDER's unresolved words: "I am taking back my house.", leaving the outcome hanging.
why_it_works: At 22s, this promo draws viewer into a clear character dilemma and leaves the audience needing immediate resolution, delivering an emotionally complete micro-drama hook.
weaknesses: Slower opening pacing; first 2 seconds lack an aggressive visual or audio shock. Cut-point does not end on an explicit question or shock line, reducing click urgency. Opens on a wide camera shot without immediate dialogue, risking mobile feed scroll-by.

events_summary.content: Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.
Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's hand adjusting the ornate golden lion crest pinned at his cravat.
Medium low-angle shot as a loyalist soldier drops down onto one knee before him in the snow.

events_summary.speaker: LOYALIST
events_summary.content: Your Grace.
Close-up profile of Alexander, his breath pluming in the winter cold, his eyes hardened like steel.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: Secure the chapel.
Medium close-up of the soldier rising and snapping a crisp military salute.

events_summary.speaker: LOYALIST
events_summary.content: Yes, Your Grace.
Slow dramatic tracking shot moving backward in front of Alexander as he strides purposefully through the deep snow, the wooden chapel looming in the distance behind him.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: No more hiding.

events_summary.speaker: ALEXANDER
events_summary.content: I am taking back my house.
